evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: The 'we ratified' enacts communal-sharing: a collective body ratifying as one, undifferentiated in the act of agreement.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The either/or framing of reciprocal exchange paths — poll or receive piggybacked — enacts equality-matching: turn-taking alternatives structured as even, one-for-one options.
